summary: The lord of gains on the lagna: income, ambitions and social networks attach to the person, who is classically wealthy, happy, even-minded and eloquent.
common_outcomes: wealthy, happy, even-minded, a poet and eloquent speaker (BPHS 24.121)
born into a rich family, very rich, fairly rich or well-to-do as the lord is strong, middling or weak (Raman HTJH); born wealthy (Braha)
gains through one's own effort (Rath Crux 14.8)
achieves desires; many opportunities and beneficial friends (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 22.8: 11th lord in the 1st with the lagna lord joined with the 11th indicates a notable gain around age 33 (traditional timing)
JP 11.62: the 11th lord in the 1st brings treasure or other valuable property
Raman gives early loss of an elder brother and Rath ill-health for the native (Crux 14.8) as traditional lines; never predict

by_area.career: Gains come through one's own effort (Rath Crux 14.8).
by_area.finance: Wealthy (BPHS 24.121); family wealth at birth scaled by the lord's strength (Raman HTJH); BPHS 22.2 counts the 11th lord in a kendra as giving much gain.
by_area.relationships: Beneficial friends; happiness from the eldest sibling (Braha).

strengtheners: a strong 11th lord: born into a very rich family (Raman HTJH); exaltation (BPHS 22.2)
lagna lord linked to the 11th (BPHS 22.8)
weakeners_or_cancellations: debilitation or malefic affliction (BPHS 22.11 for afflicted 11th lords generally)

Frawley (p. 160) treats the 11th lord as generally malefic in health terms and inclined to make the character egoistic or impulsive, though good for gains; Rath also reads the 11th lord in or aspecting the lagna as unfavourable for the native's health (Crux 14.8)
lagna_or_context_notes: Dual lordship matters: Saturn (10th+11th) for Aries, Jupiter (8th+11th) for Taurus, Mars (6th+11th) for Gemini, Mercury (8th+11th) for Scorpio, Venus (6th+11th) for Sagittarius, Saturn (11th+12th) for Pisces. BPHS 24.146-147: both lordships give results.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 24.121
source_views.view: Pure-natured, wealthy, happy, even-minded, a poet and eloquent speaker.

source_views.source: Brihat Parashara Hora Shastra 22.2, 22.8
source_views.view: 11th lord in a kendra, trikona or the 11th, or exalted, gives much gain; in the 1st with the lagna lord joined, a notable gain around age 33.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XV 'Results of the Lord of the Eleventh House Occupying Different Houses'
source_views.view: Born into a rich family, very rich, fairly rich or well-to-do as the lord is strong, middling or weak; earns much; loses an elder brother early (traditional).

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '11th House' chapter, 'The lord of the 11th placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Wealthy, many opportunities, achieves desires and ambitions, born into a wealthy family, beneficial friends, happiness from the eldest sibling.

source_views.source: Sanjay Rath, Crux of Vedic Astrology: Timing of Events, 14.8 (placement of the eleventh lord)
source_views.view: In the 1st (or aspecting it) the gain is through one's own effort; the house occupied by the 11th lord shows ill-health for that relation, so here the native may suffer; the 11th lord in the 1st, 2nd or 8th is also said to curtail longevity (traditional).

source_views.source: Jataka Parijata (Vaidyanatha; tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri, Vol. II) XI.62
source_views.view: If the lagna lord is in the 2nd and the 2nd lord in the 11th, or if the 11th lord is in the 1st, the person gets treasure or other valuable property.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'The Houses: The Domains of Planetary Action', 'House Lords as Specific Significators', pp. 159-160
source_views.view: The 11th lord, though generally malefic for health and prone to make the character egoistic or impulsive, is still the lord of gains: good for acquisitions and work with groups. Mercury as 2nd and 11th lord for Leo is a double significator of wealth. Saturn as 11th and 12th lord for Pisces is very inauspicious, as the 11th is a difficult house.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.29
source_views.view: Note the bhava occupied by the 11th lord and the bhava owned by any planet joined with it: gain of things connected with those bhavas may be predicted.

disagreements: BPHS, Raman and Braha are favourable for wealth. Braha gives happiness from the eldest sibling while Raman gives early loss of an elder brother, and Rath and Frawley add health cautions; treat the sibling and health lines as unreliable.
phrasing_guidance: Describe good earning ability and sociability. Give the age-33 note only as traditional timing for a specific combination.

summary: The lord of gains in the house of wealth: a classic dhana yoga, giving abundant wealth, accomplishment, generosity and happiness.
common_outcomes: abundant wealth; accomplished, generous, righteous and happy (BPHS 24.122)
earns through commerce and banking (Raman HTJH); banking or money-lending (Braha)
lives with or is helped by elder siblings (Raman HTJH; Braha)
gains by using family wealth or other assets (Rath Crux 14.8)
profitable business with friends (Raman HTJH; Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 22.3: with the 2nd lord in a kendra and Jupiter linked, great gains
BPHS 22.9: exchange of 2nd and 11th lords gives great fortune after marriage
with the 2nd lord as well: large sums; with the 9th lord too, in exaltation or own vargas, a millionaire (Raman HTJH, combinations)
Frawley (Example Charts: Nelson Rockefeller, Virgo lagna): the Moon as 11th lord waxing in the 2nd house of income

by_area.personality: Generous, accomplished, righteous (BPHS 24.122); intelligent and a good speaker (Braha).
by_area.finance: Abundant wealth (BPHS 24.122); several sources of income (Braha); family assets put to use (Rath Crux 14.8).
by_area.relationships: Exchange case links fortune to marriage (BPHS 22.9).
by_area.family: Lives with elder brothers: benefics give harmony, malefics domestic bickering (Raman HTJH); domestic happiness (Braha).

strengtheners: 2nd lord in a kendra and Jupiter associated (BPHS 22.3)
exchange with the 2nd lord (BPHS 22.9)
joined with the 2nd and 9th lords in exaltation or own vargas (Raman HTJH)
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefics joining: heavy losses on account of friends (Raman HTJH)
the 11th lord in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the navamsa lagna gives only moderate results (Raman HTJH)
lagna_or_context_notes: For Aquarius lagna Jupiter owns the 2nd and 11th and sits in Pisces, own sign. For Leo lagna Mercury owns the 2nd and 11th and sits in Virgo, own sign and exalted; Frawley (p. 160) calls Mercury for Leo a double significator of wealth, though somewhat malefic for health.

summary: Gains through effort, skills and siblings: the person is skilful and wealthy and enjoys siblings' support. Both houses are upachayas, so results grow with time.

gains through brothers; many friends and helpful neighbours (Raman HTJH; Braha)
may earn as a singer or musician (Raman HTJH); gains from music, drama or literature (Braha)
desires and ambitions fulfilled: a kama lord in a kama house (Braha)

with the 3rd lord: brothers as business partners and writing ability (Raman HTJH, combinations)
Frawley (Example Charts: Mick Jagger, Taurus lagna): Jupiter, exalted as 11th lord in the 3rd, gives good financial gains
BPHS 24.123 mentions occasional fear of colic; do not use as a health prediction

by_area.family: Gains through brothers (Raman HTJH; Braha); in the exchange case, wealth through brothers (BPHS 22.10).

many children who do well (Raman HTJH); gains and happiness from children (Braha)
gains through speculation and investments (Raman HTJH; Braha)
intelligent and learned (Braha)

summary: The gains lord in a dusthana: classically gains are blocked and the person faces opponents and restlessness, though Raman and Braha name specific gains through litigation, maternal relatives and health-related ventures.

gains through maternal relatives, litigation or running nursing homes (Raman HTJH); gains through an uncle or health-related ventures (Braha)
difficulty fulfilling desires; few windfalls (Braha)
problems with friends (Braha)
rare_outcomes: Phaladeepika's Daridra yoga (11th lord in 6/8/12): debts, poverty, harsh speech; traditional view
BPHS 24.126 mentions illness and a 'cruel intellect'; state carefully
with the 6th lord: success as a lawyer and through litigation, good earnings (Raman HTJH, combinations)
afflicted: involvement in other people's quarrels (Raman HTJH); traditional
Frawley (Example Charts: Franklin Roosevelt, Leo lagna): Venus, ruler of the 11th ('a malefic lord'), with the lagna lord Sun in the 6th is read as a health factor

by_area.career: Law and litigation, nursing homes or health-related ventures (Raman HTJH; Braha).
by_area.finance: BPHS 22.11: in a trika house with malefics, gain does not come despite great effort; few windfalls (Braha).
by_area.family: Gains through maternal relatives (Raman HTJH) or an uncle (Braha).

debilitation (BPHS 22.11)

summary: Gains through spouse and partners: BPHS 24.127 gives gains from the spouse's family, generosity and virtue, with the spouse strongly influential.
common_outcomes: gains through the spouse's family; generous, virtuous; influenced by the wife (BPHS 24.127)
a wealthy or influential spouse who helps gain wealth (Braha); fortified, a rich and influential wife (Raman HTJH)
prospers in foreign countries (Raman HTJH)
gains from business and in-laws (Rath Crux 14.8)
desires fulfilled: a kama lord in a kama house (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 22.11 lists the 11th lord in the 7th among conditions where gains are blocked (with malefics); contrasts with 24.127
Raman indicates more than one marriage, or one marriage to a rich spouse if the lord is fortified; afflicted, traditional lines on immoral liaisons; treat with great care
Rath: the 11th lord in the 7th is 9th from its own house, implying good fortune and a religious nature; he also reads the 7th placement as a health worry for the spouse (Crux 14.8); never predict
with the 7th lord: a rich wife, influential friends and successful partnerships; with a strong Sun, may go abroad as an ambassador (Raman HTJH, combinations)

affliction of the 11th lord (Raman HTJH)

summary: The gains lord in the house of obstacles: all sources see setbacks and losses, with Braha adding gains through a partner's money, insurance and legacies.
common_outcomes: setbacks in undertakings (BPHS 24.128)
though rich at birth, many calamities and loss of money (Raman HTJH); many financial losses (Braha)
losses through thieves, cheats and swindlers (Raman HTJH)
gains from a partner's wealth, insurance or wills (Braha)
desires unfulfilled; few or bad friends (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.128 states long life and that the spouse may pass first; do not use either as a prediction
Phaladeepika's Daridra yoga as a traditional caution
the 11th lord in a malefic nakshatra: a traditional poverty line (Raman HTJH)
with the 8th lord in the 8th: debts and domestic disharmony, yet success in small manual ventures (Raman HTJH, combinations)

by_area.career: Small ventures with manual labour succeed (Raman HTJH, combinations).
by_area.finance: Losses through calamities and fraud (Raman HTJH); gains from a partner's wealth, insurance or wills (Braha); BPHS 22.11: gain may not come despite effort when afflicted.
by_area.family: Little happiness from the eldest sibling (Braha).

strengtheners: strong lord (Phaladeepika 15.9); benefic aspect (15.5)
own-sign case: for Taurus lagna Jupiter owns 8th and 11th and is in Sagittarius here; for Scorpio Mercury owns 8th and 11th and is in Gemini here
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefic association (BPHS 22.11)
a malefic nakshatra (Raman HTJH)
lagna_or_context_notes: The Taurus and Scorpio own-sign cases are milder. Results scale with strength (BPHS 24.145-148).

source_views.view: Though rich at birth, suffers calamities and loses much money to thieves, cheats and swindlers; in a malefic nakshatra, traditional poverty.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XV 'Important Combinations' (11th lord with the lord of the house it occupies)
source_views.view: With the 8th lord in the 8th: pecuniary losses, debts, a business that does not thrive, domestic disharmony, but success in small ventures with manual labour.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '11th House' chapter, 'The lord of the 11th placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Many financial losses, few opportunities, desires unfulfilled, no happiness from the eldest sibling, few or bad friends; gains from a partner's wealth, insurance or wills.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.29
source_views.view: Note the bhava occupied by the 11th lord and the bhava owned by any planet joined with it: gain of things connected with those bhavas may be predicted.

disagreements: BPHS, Phaladeepika, Raman and Braha are all negative on gains; Braha adds gains through a partner's money, insurance and legacies.
phrasing_guidance: Say gains may be irregular or come through unexpected channels. Never mention the spouse's death or longevity; omit that classical line in readings.

summary: Gains through fortune, dharma and elders: the person is fortunate, clever, truthful, wealthy and honoured by authorities.
common_outcomes: fortunate, clever, truthful, honoured by rulers, wealthy (BPHS 24.129)
inherits a large paternal fortune; very lucky (Raman HTJH; Braha)
many houses, vehicles and luxuries (Raman HTJH)
religious and charitable; may set up charitable institutions (Raman HTJH)
gains through higher learning, travel, the father or temples (Rath Crux 14.8)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 22.5: 11th lord in a trikona with benefics, notable gain around age 40 (traditional timing)
Frawley (Example Charts: Lord Rama, Cancer lagna): Venus as 11th lord exalted in the 9th is part of a very strong wealth picture
with the 9th lord: an aristocratic background, extends the family business, foreign collaboration (Raman HTJH, combinations)

by_area.career: Higher learning, travel, temples (Rath Crux 14.8); extends the family business (Raman HTJH, combinations).
by_area.finance: A large paternal fortune (Raman HTJH; Braha); BPHS 22.2 counts a trikona as giving much gain.
by_area.family: A wealthy, long-lived father; happiness from the eldest sibling (Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Disseminates religious literature and sets up charities (Raman HTJH).

strengtheners: benefic association (BPHS 22.5)
joined with the 9th lord (Raman HTJH, combinations)
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefic affliction or debilitation (BPHS 22.11)

summary: Gains through career and status: the person is honoured by authorities, virtuous, dutiful, truthful and self-controlled.
common_outcomes: honoured by kings, virtuous, dutiful, truthful, self-controlled (BPHS 24.130)
prospers in business with good profits (Raman HTJH); a prosperous career with many opportunities (Braha)
an elder brother helps in business or career (Raman HTJH; Braha)
prizes or awards for original contributions in one's field (Raman HTJH)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 22.5: kendra placement with benefics gives a notable gain around age 40 (traditional timing)
JP 12.104: exchange of the 10th and 11th lords gives ornaments and vehicles
earns by fair or foul means according to the benefic or malefic nature of the planet (Raman HTJH)
with the 10th lord: more than one occupation and a distinguished career (Raman HTJH, combinations)

by_area.career: Business prosperity and awards (Raman HTJH); many career opportunities (Braha).
by_area.finance: Good profits (Raman HTJH); BPHS 22.2: kendra placement gives much gain.
by_area.family: An elder brother assists (Raman HTJH; Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Performs good deeds and goes on pilgrimages (Braha).

strengtheners: benefic association (BPHS 22.5); a benefic 11th lord earns by fair means (Raman HTJH)
exchange with the 10th lord (JP 12.104)
weakeners_or_cancellations: a malefic 11th lord earns by foul means (Raman HTJH); malefics afflicting the 10th make one powerful but unscrupulous (Raman HTJH, combinations)
lagna_or_context_notes: For Aries lagna Saturn owns 10th and 11th and is in Capricorn, own sign, here.

summary: The gains lord in its own house: gains come in all endeavours, and wisdom and happiness grow over time.
common_outcomes: gains in all endeavours; wisdom and happiness grow daily (BPHS 24.131)
many friends and helpful elder siblings (Raman HTJH; Braha)
a happy life with spouse, home, children and comforts (Raman HTJH)
easy gains and many financial opportunities (Braha)
rare_outcomes: succeeds without much effort; the planet shows the trade: Jupiter books and religion, Saturn industry, Venus arts and hospitality, Mercury writing and teaching, Mars land and metals, the Sun hereditary work and banking, the Moon farming and dairy (Raman HTJH, combinations)

by_area.career: The planet's nature shows the field of earning (Raman HTJH, combinations).
by_area.finance: Easy gains (Braha); BPHS 22.2 names the 11th lord in the 11th as giving much gain.
by_area.family: Powerful, prosperous elder siblings (Raman HTJH; Braha).
by_area.spirituality: Money spent on legitimate and charitable purposes (Raman HTJH, combinations).

strengtheners: the lord is in its own sign (BPHS 22.2: much gain); benefics in the 11th augment its significations (Raman HTJH)
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefics in the 11th diminish its significations (Raman HTJH)
lagna_or_context_notes: Sign depends on lagna, e.g. Saturn in Aquarius for Aries, Sun in Leo for Libra, Moon in Cancer for Virgo.

summary: The gains lord in the house of expenditure: gains tend to flow out, often to good causes, and the person may have strong desires and dealings with foreigners or outsiders.
common_outcomes: spends on good causes; strong desires; associates with outsiders (BPHS 24.132)
losses in business; frequent fines and penalties (Raman HTJH)
expenses on account of an elder sibling's troubles (Raman HTJH; Braha)
many financial losses and unfulfilled desires (Braha)
rare_outcomes: BPHS 24.132 says lustful with many wives; a traditional line, not to be used as character judgement
Phaladeepika's Daridra yoga as a traditional caution
with the 12th lord: losses through varied expenditure; in the 6th, 8th or 12th from the navamsa lagna, debts (Raman HTJH, combinations)
comfortable bed pleasures (Braha)

by_area.finance: Gains flow out; fines and penalties (Raman HTJH); BPHS 22.11: in a trika house with malefics, gains fail despite effort.
by_area.relationships: Few or bad friends (Braha). Traditional texts link it with multiple relationships (BPHS 24.132); treat with great care.
by_area.family: Burdened with domestic responsibilities; expenses for an elder sibling (Raman HTJH; Braha).

strengtheners: strong lord (Phaladeepika 15.9); benefic aspect (15.5)
own-sign case: for Pisces lagna Saturn owns 11th and 12th and is in Aquarius here
weakeners_or_cancellations: malefic association (BPHS 22.11)
malefics afflicting the 12th: wealth squandered (Raman HTJH, combinations)
lagna_or_context_notes: For Pisces lagna Saturn (11th+12th) is in its own sign Aquarius here; Frawley (p. 159) calls Saturn as 11th and 12th lord for Pisces very inauspicious, the 11th being itself a difficult house. Results scale with strength (BPHS 24.145-148).

source_views.view: Losses in business; an ailing elder brother and expenses on his illness; frequent fines and penalties; many domestic responsibilities.

source_views.source: B.V. Raman, How to Judge a Horoscope Vol. II, ch. XV 'Important Combinations' (11th lord with the lord of the house it occupies)
source_views.view: With the 12th lord: losses through varied expenditure; with an afflicted 12th, wealth squandered; in the 6th/8th/12th from the navamsa lagna, debts.

source_views.source: James Braha, Ancient Hindu Astrology for the Modern Western Astrologer, '11th House' chapter, 'The lord of the 11th placed in the' houses
source_views.view: Many financial losses, few opportunities, desires unfulfilled, losses and debts through the eldest sibling, few or bad friends, good bed pleasures.

source_views.source: David Frawley, The Astrology of the Seers, ch. 'The Houses: The Domains of Planetary Action', 'House Lords as Specific Significators', pp. 159-160
source_views.view: The 11th lord, though generally malefic for health and prone to make the character egoistic or impulsive, is still the lord of gains: good for acquisitions and work with groups. Mercury as 2nd and 11th lord for Leo is a double significator of wealth. Saturn as 11th and 12th lord for Pisces is very inauspicious, as the 11th is a difficult house.

source_views.source: Phaladeepika (tr. V. Subrahmanya Sastri) 16.29
source_views.view: Note the bhava occupied by the 11th lord and the bhava owned by any planet joined with it: gain of things connected with those bhavas may be predicted.

disagreements: BPHS 24.132 includes spending on good causes alongside negative lines; Phaladeepika, Raman and Braha are wholly negative on gains. For Pisces lagna the own-sign placement does not rescue the result in Frawley's view.
phrasing_guidance: Say income may flow to travel, charity or distant ventures and that budgeting helps. Do not repeat the 'many wives' or 'lustful' line.
